fusions.name: Vine-Swing Arrival
fusions.desc: Coils the lash round an enemy up to 7 tiles away and swings you to it, which deals 13 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Thrashing Bough
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Thrashes the lash around you with both arms, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Troop Rally
fusions.desc: Cracks a challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Working Up a Temper
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
